name: Navigate established romantic and personal relationships
description: Users sought advice on navigating existing romantic or intimate partnerships, focusing on resolving conflicts, communicating needs, and addressing specific relational challenges such as infidelity, breakups, or partner unreceptivity. Some requests extended to non-romantic personal dynamics, including interactions with former teachers or friends, but the dominant theme remained managing established interpersonal bonds rather than initiating new romantic connections.
